# MAKENOV

> MAKENOV (메이크노브) là nền tảng B2B kết nối sản phẩm đổi mới toàn cầu với nhà phân phối tại Việt Nam. / 메이크노브는 글로벌 혁신 제품과 베트남 유통 파트너를 연결하는 B2B 플랫폼입니다. / MAKENOV is a B2B platform connecting innovative products from global suppliers with distribution partners in Vietnam.

Website: https://vn.makenov.com/ (vi) · https://kr.makenov.com/index.html (ko) · https://en.makenov.com/index.html (en)
Contact: notice@makenov.com
Languages: Vietnamese, Korean, English

## What MAKENOV does
- Lists innovative products from verified suppliers (mainly Korea) by category: beauty, food & beverage, living, health, kids, tech.
- Trade terms (supply price, MOQ, lead time) are unlocked only for distribution partners that pass a free business verification (Vietnam: tax code MST; Korea: business registration number).
- Inquiries go directly to the supplier. MAKENOV supports supplier connection, communication, interpretation and online/offline meetings.
- Exclusive or official distribution rights can be discussed per product ("negotiable" badge).
- Registration, browsing, verification and inquiries are free.

## Frequently asked
- Is it free? Yes — signup, browsing, business verification and quote inquiries are free.
- Why are price and MOQ locked? They are B2B trade terms shown only to verified businesses; verification takes about a minute.
- Do I deal with the supplier directly? Yes; quotes and terms are negotiated with the supplier, and MAKENOV supports the process (connection, communication, meetings).
- Can I start without import experience? Yes; start by finding a product and leaving an inquiry.
